description_en: Modifies the information of a historical task in the task center
description_zh: 修改任务中心的历史任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-task-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id t-83br18hloum8u3948s --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610399.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610399.html查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can call the DescribeTasks operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the execution step
parameters.name: step_name

parameters.help_en: The task action. Set the value to modifySwitchTime, which indicates modifying the switchover time or recovery time
parameters.help_zh: 任务操作，取值modifySwitchTime，表示修改切换时间或恢复时间
parameters.name: task_action

parameters.help_en:
The action-related parameters, which can be extended as needed. When taskAction is set to modifySwitchTime, set ActionParams to `{"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`.

recoverMode specifies the task recovery pattern. Valid values:
timePoint: Execute at a specified point in time.
immediate: Execute immediately.

recoverTime specifies the recovery time in UTC+0. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. This parameter is required when recoverMode is set to timePoint
parameters.help_zh:
动作相关的参数，根据业务需要扩展，当taskAction取modifySwitchTime时，ActionParams取值` {"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`。

recoverMode表示任务恢复模式，取值说明：
timePoint：按照时间点执行
immediate：立即执行

recoverTime表示恢复时间，UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。当recoverMode取timePoint时，recoverTime必填
parameters.name: action_params

ErrorTaskId.description_en: The ID of the failed task. The first failed task ID is returned
ErrorTaskId.description_zh: 失败的任务ID，遇到一个失败即返回
